## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
CAUTION. Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive; confirmation: broad sector participation (8/11) but material megacap divergences among large-tech names and several major financials showing weakness. Leadership: Broad (Top 5 span 4 sectors), so cautionary stance until megacap trends reconcile.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Real Estate leads: EQIX (1W: +18.61% | 1M: +19.54%) ABOVE TREND, CCI (1W: +12.05% | 1M: +1.15%) ABOVE TREND, AMT (1W: +9.74% | 1M: +8.18%) ABOVE TREND. Industrials strong: CAT (1W: +11.79% | 1M: +19.41%) ABOVE TREND. Materials showing strength: NEM (1W: +8.84% | 1M: +3.04%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Technology lagging: GOOGL (1W: -6.72% | 1M: -8.03%) BELOW TREND, AAPL (1W: -5.05% | 1M: +0.35%) CORRECTION, MSFT (1W: +2.08% | 1M: -14.62%) RECOVERY. Financials weak: WFC (1W: -5.76% | 1M: -7.32%) BELOW TREND, SCHW (1W: -6.78% | 1M: -6.03%) BELOW TREND. Consumer Discretionary soft: AMZN (1W: -10.37% | 1M: -17.72%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: EQIX (1W: +18.61% | 1M: +19.54%) ABOVE TREND; ORCL (1W: +14.65% | 1M: -22.65%) RECOVERY; CCI (1W: +12.05% | 1M: +1.15%) ABOVE TREND; CAT (1W: +11.79% | 1M: +19.41%) ABOVE TREND; EL (1W: +10.10% | 1M: -7.76%) RECOVERY. Leadership: Broad (4 sectors in Top 5) — positive for selective rotation.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: WFC (1W: -5.76% | 1M: -7.32%) BELOW TREND; TMO (1W: -6.00% | 1M: -16.02%) BELOW TREND; NFLX (1W: -6.20% | 1M: -16.01%) BELOW TREND; BKNG (1W: -6.40% | 1M: -21.74%) BELOW TREND; GOOGL (1W: -6.72% | 1M: -8.03%) BELOW TREND. Weakness concentrated in several large-cap growth names and select cyclically sensitive services.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Strongest 1W movers: EQIX (1W: +18.61%), ORCL (1W: +14.65%), CCI (1W: +12.05%), CAT (1W: +11.79%), EL (1W: +10.10%) — watch ORCL and EL as RECOVERY candidates. Note MAJOR divergence across megacaps (AAPL, MSFT, META) — treat as tactical, not structural.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Mixed with corrective action in large caps. NVDA (1W: +8.76% | 1M: +0.61%) ABOVE TREND, AAPL (1W: -5.05% | 1M: +0.35%) CORRECTION, MSFT (1W: +2.08% | 1M: -14.62%) RECOVERY; sector 1W: -0.36% | 1M: -9.38% (19 stocks) — internal rotation and headline risk remain.

8. Financials Outlook?
Under pressure and broadly BELOW TREND: WFC (1W: -5.76% | 1M: -7.32%) BELOW TREND, SCHW (1W: -6.78% | 1M: -6.03%) BELOW TREND, JPM (1W: -2.42% | 1M: -2.66%) BELOW TREND; sector 1W: -2.50% | 1M: -2.53% (20 stocks) — watch for spillover if earnings news deteriorates.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Defensive bid visible and mixed recovery signals. JNJ (1W: +2.84% | 1M: +14.46%) ABOVE TREND, PFE (1W: +3.70% | 1M: +11.05%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +1.71% | 1M: -3.61%) RECOVERY; sector 1W: +1.05% | 1M: +1.22% (15 stocks) — supportive for lower-vol exposure.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor Value/Cyclical names showing leadership (CAT, XOM, CVX, EQIX, AMT) and reduce exposure to several large-cap tech names showing correction or sustained weakness (AAPL, GOOGL, AMZN). Style: Value/Cyclical favored while monitoring megacap divergence for confirmation.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: AMAT (1W: +8.03% | 1M: +7.71%) ABOVE TREND — news confirmed; CAT (1W: +11.79% | 1M: +19.41%) ABOVE TREND — momentum. BEARISH: AMZN (1W: -10.37% | 1M: -17.72%) BELOW TREND — weak price despite product initiatives, GOOGL (1W: -6.72% | 1M: -8.03%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Real Estate, Industrials, Materials (8/11 sectors positive overall; these sectors showing the cleanest 1W strength). BEARISH: Technology and Financials — watch mega-cap tech divergences and financials’ earnings/credit headlines.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
NVDA (1W: +8.76% | 1M: +0.61%) ABOVE TREND — watch for follow-through above this week’s breakout for broader tech participation. AAPL (1W: -5.05% | 1M: +0.35%) CORRECTION — watch reclaim of recent weekly highs to reduce risk. CAT (1W: +11.79% | 1M: +19.41%) ABOVE TREND — confirmation if weekly strength holds on higher volumes.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
AMAT (+55): Applied Materials (1W: +8.03% | 1M: +7.71%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment and price confirming. DD (+55): DuPont (1W: +8.21% | 1M: +12.88%) ABOVE TREND — earnings-led strength confirmed. AMZN (+50): Amazon (1W: -10.37% | 1M: -17.72%) BELOW TREND — sentiment positive but price diverging (distribution risk).

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
CCI (-45): Crown Castle (1W: +12.05% | 1M: +1.15%) ABOVE TREND — negative headlines diverging from price (watch for profit-taking). TSLA (-45): Tesla (1W: +5.00% | 1M: -6.74%) RECOVERY — negative headlines vs short-term bounce; monitor for trend break. FCX (-45) noted in feed but price confirmation needed; treat as watchlist.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

CAUTION; rotation favors Value/Cyclical style amid broad sector participation but megacap divergences. EQIX (1W: +18.61% | 1M: +19.54%) ABOVE TREND, CAT (1W: +11.79% | 1M: +19.41%) ABOVE TREND, AMAT (1W: +8.03% | 1M: +7.71%) ABOVE TREND showing relative strength. Key risk: major-tech divergence (AAPL/META/MSFT) and mixed news vs price (e.g., AMZN, CCI) — monitor for trend breaks before adding beta.
